# does your submission require gpu for evaluation (inflation)?
yes

# did you include the compression script? and want it to be merged?
no

# additional comments
qpose14 is a rate-optimized Quantizr-style neural renderer variant. The improvement is a quantized pose side-channel plus single-member archive packing to reduce zip overhead. Validated on CUDA using Google Colab.
